question: Which key combination is commonly used for copying text in many text editing applications in Windows?
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

The **Ctrl+C** key combination works by transferring the selected text or object to the clipboard, which is a temporary memory location. Users can then paste the copied content into another location or application using the **Ctrl+V** command. This feature significantly enhances productivity by simplifying repetitive tasks such as duplicating text, data, or files.

**Steps to Copy Text Using Ctrl+C:**

 
• Select the text or object you want to copy. This can be done by dragging the cursor over the text or using keyboard shortcuts such as **Shift + Arrow Keys** for precise selection.
 
• Press **Ctrl+C** on your keyboard. This action copies the selected content to the clipboard.
 
• Navigate to the location where you want to paste the copied content and press **Ctrl+V** to paste it.

**Advantages of Ctrl+C:**

 
• **Efficiency:** Saves time by eliminating the need to manually retype or recreate content.
 
• **Universality:** Works across most applications in the Windows operating system, including word processors, spreadsheets, browsers, and graphic design software.
 
• **Ease of Use:** Requires only a simple key combination, making it accessible to users of varying technical proficiency.

**Correct Option Analysis:**

The correct option is:

**Option 3:** Ctrl+C

This option accurately represents the universally accepted keyboard shortcut for copying text in Windows. It is used in almost all text editing and data management applications and is an integral part of the copy-paste functionality.
